mapper.select: SELECT script_sbst FROM MSF_TRANSCRIPTION_SCRIPT WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND to_char(now(), 'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN use_start_date AND use_end_date AND ( (#{mnp3TgtYn} = 'Y' AND mnp3_tgt_yn = 'Y') OR (#{nac3TgtYn} = 'Y' AND nac3_tgt_yn = 'Y') OR (#{hdn3TgtYn} = 'Y' AND hdn3_tgt_yn = 'Y') OR (#{icn3TgtYn} = 'Y' AND icn3_tgt_yn = 'Y') ) AND ( req_buy_type_cd IS NULL OR req_buy_type_cd = '' OR ( (#{reqBuyTypeCd} = 'MM' AND req_buy_type_cd LIKE '%MM%') OR (#{reqBuyTypeCd} = 'UU' AND req_buy_type_cd LIKE '%UU%') ) ) AND ( form_tgt_dtl IS NULL OR form_tgt_dtl = '' OR ( (#{cstmrSelf} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%CSTMR_SELF%') OR (#{cstmrAgent} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%CSTMR_AGENT%') OR (#{enggN} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%ENGG_N%') OR (#{enggY} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%ENGG_Y%') OR (#{enggKd} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%ENGG_KD%') OR (#{enggPm} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%ENGG_PM%') OR (#{rmndY} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%RMND_Y%') OR (#{rateY} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%RATE_Y%') OR (#{insrY} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%INSR_Y%') OR (#{addY} = 'Y' AND form_tgt_dtl LIKE '%ADD_Y%') ) ) ORDER BY sort_odrg

SELECT REQ.SHOP_NM AS cntpntCdNm, USR.USER_NM AS userNm, CST.CSTMR_NM AS nflCustNm, SAL.SOC_NM AS mobilePriceNm, CAST(SAL.SOC_BASE_CHRG_AMT AS VARCHAR) AS mobileMntcntAmtFee, REQ.REQ_MODEL_NM AS mdlNm, CAST(SAL.MODEL_PRICE AS VARCHAR) AS handsetThecpl, REQ.REQ_MODEL_NM AS mobileMdlNm, CAST(SAL.MODEL_PRICE AS VARCHAR) AS mobileHandsetThecpl, CASE WHEN UPPER(SAL.SPRT_TYPE_CD) = 'PM' THEN '요금할인' WHEN UPPER(SAL.SPRT_TYPE_CD) = 'KD' THEN '단말할인' WHEN UPPER(SAL.SPRT_TYPE_CD) = 'SM' THEN '심플할인' ELSE SAL.SPRT_TYPE_CD END AS dscnOptnCdNm, CAST(SAL.MODEL_SPRT AS VARCHAR) AS mobileTotSupotAmnt, '0' AS mobileStorSupotAmnt, CAST(SAL.MODEL_INSTAMT AS VARCHAR) AS mobileInstAmnt, CAST( CAST( TRUNC( TRUNC( COALESCE( ((CAST(SAL.MODEL_INSTAMT AS NUMERIC) * 0.059 / 12) * POWER((0.059 / 12) + 1, CAST(SAL.MODEL_MONTHLY AS NUMERIC))) / NULLIF((POWER((0.059 / 12) + 1, CAST(SAL.MODEL_MONTHLY AS NUMERIC)) - 1), 0) , 0) , 0) * CAST(SAL.MODEL_MONTHLY AS NUMERIC) - CAST(SAL.MODEL_INSTAMT AS NUMERIC) , 0) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) AS mobileInstInt, CAST(SAL.ENGG_MNTH_CNT AS VARCHAR) AS mobileEnggPrd, CAST(SAL.MODEL_MONTHLY AS VARCHAR) AS mobileInstPrd, CAST(SAL.ENGG_MNTH_CNT AS VARCHAR) AS enggPrd, CAST(SAL.DC_AMT AS VARCHAR) AS mmFeeDscn, CAST(SAL.MODEL_SPRT AS VARCHAR) AS totSupotAmnt, '0' AS storSupotAmnt, REQ.REQ_ADDITION_LIST_NM AS mobileVasNm, CAST(REQ.REQ_ADDITION_PRICE AS VARCHAR) AS mobileVasTotalPrice, (SELECT prod_nm FROM MSF_RATE_ADSVC_CTG_PROD_REL WHERE prod_id = REQ.INSR_PROD_CD LIMIT 1) AS shphcrNm FROM MSF_REQUEST_TEMP REQ INNER JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR_TEMP CST ON REQ.REQUEST_KEY = CST.REQUEST_KEY INNER JOIN MSF_REQUEST_SALE_TEMP SAL ON REQ.REQUEST_KEY = SAL.REQUEST_KEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MSF_USER_INFO USR ON REQ.CRET_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE REQ.REQUEST_KEY = #{requestKey}
